subject: Request: Exec approval for >20% Hosted API usage discount for Brixton Labs
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec approval for >20% Hosted API usage discount for Brixton Labs

Team —

Quick context: Brixton Labs (Series B, ML-driven clinical workflows) is at risk of going to Competitor X unless we come back with a meaningful economics play. They’re proposing a 12-month committed usage with a 6-month ramp and are forecasting ~120k USD/month nominal Hosted API spend at list. They asked us for a 28% off list price to match their procurement threshold.

Why this matters:
- Strategic partner signal: Brixton is piloting integrations that could feed our marketplace and a referral program for North American health systems.
- Retention risk: They have an existing POC with Competitor X and procurement is pressing for a single-vendor discount.
- Upside: If we secure a committed 12-month contract with volume floors + usage escalation, long-term unit economics improve and we get marketplace/bundle exposure.

What I’m asking: Exec approval to offer a one-time concession up to 30% off Hosted API usage rates (flat per-token rate) contingent on: 1) 12-month committed term with minimum monthly committed spend; 2) clear termination and overage language; 3) Legal to sign off on the attached redlines. If full 30% is not comfortable, request approval for at least 25% so we can move the deal.

Attachments: Brixton-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan), usage-forecast-6mo.xlsx (volume model), redlines_v1.docx (initial contract redlines).

Notes: I’ve already proposed tiered alternatives (25% + credits for onboarding), but procurement pushed for a single % concession. If you’re ok, I will loop Ben and Legal and send an approved terms letter to Samir.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for >20% Hosted API usage discount for Brixton Labs

Jordan —

Thanks for the write-up, this reads well and I agree the account is strategic. A couple of asks before Ben signs off: can Finance (Mina) confirm NPV impact for 12 months at both 25% and 30% and include a sensitivity if actual usage comes in 15% below forecast? Also include proposed minimum monthly commitment language (I’d prefer $65k/mo floor).

If Finance is green, I’m supportive of escalating to Ben for a one-time exec concession. Please make the ask explicit to Ben in your next message (exact % and conditions).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for >20% Hosted API usage discount for Brixton Labs

Added modeling in the attached sheet: at the forecasted volumes a 25% concession reduces ARR by ~18% in year 1 vs list, but the committed revenue (with $65k/mo floor) still nets positive cash and improves retention probability significantly. A 30% concession becomes marginal on margin unless we secure tighter minimums (I recommend $75k/mo) and a clause to true-up if usage underperforms by >20%.

Recommendation: approve up to 25% today to get the contract signed; approve up to 30% only if Ben confirms strategic waiver and we require the $75k floor and stronger termination/overage protections. I’ve flagged the specific rows in usage-forecast-6mo.xlsx.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for >20% Hosted API usage discount for Brixton Labs

Appreciate the clear ask and modeling. I’m willing to approve a one-time executive concession up to 30% off Hosted API usage rates for Brixton Labs, subject to the following firm conditions:
1) 12-month committed term with a minimum committed spend of $75,000/month (no blended floors).
2) Auto-true-up if average usage over any rolling 30-day period is >20% below the forecasted volume — vendor credit clawback applies.
3) Legal to sign off on the attached redlines and include an SLA carve-out (no change to core latency SLA).
4) Deal to be recorded under DEAL-4527 in CRM and Revenue Ops to track monthly compliance.

If Legal and Contracts are comfortable, Jordan you have approval to send the approved commercial summary to Samir and procurement. Please include Marissa on the outbound and attach the signed terms once complete.

Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brixtonlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Brixton Labs — Approved commercial summary (30% concession, conditional)

Samir —

Good news: Redwood leadership has approved a one-time concession of 30% off Hosted API usage pricing for Brixton Labs, subject to the conditions below. We appreciate your patience while we modeled the impact.

Approved commercial summary: 
- Concession: 30% off list per-token Hosted API usage rates
- Term: 12 months committed (effective upon countersignature)
- Minimum committed spend: $75,000/month (monthly floor)
- True-up: Auto-true-up and clawback if monthly usage is >20% below forecasted volumes
- Legal: Final redlines attached; Legal must sign off on contract language before countersignature

Next steps: I’ve attached the revised commercial summary and the redlined contract. If Brixton accepts these terms, please confirm and we’ll route to Legal for finalization.

Attachments: commercial_summary_Brixton_v2.pdf, redlines_v1.docx

Thanks and looking forward —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
